name: Cone Casting
summary: A cone from the hand (flashlight) selects the object closest to its axis.
howItWorks: Aim the cone at the target. Among objects inside the cone, the one nearest the central axis, then nearest the user, is selected.
advantages: Distant targets when exact ray alignment is demanding.
limitations: May create ambiguity when several candidates fall inside the cone.
